turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on days and months?
turns.tutor:
Hello! Good topic. Days and months need a small word before them:
on + day: on Monday, on Friday
in + month: in July, in May
(and at + clock time: at 7 o'clock)

Exercise: Write in, on or at:
They get married ___ April.
